items.title: Managed Agents dynamic workflows in beta
items.summary: Anthropic says Managed Agents can write programs that coordinate multiple agents in phases; the capability is in beta.

items.title: Composer predictions in Codex
items.summary: Eligible personal Pro users can try optional next-message suggestions in Codex. Suggestions are drafts and are not sent automatically.

items.title: Compliance API and Claude Docs updates
items.summary: The Compliance API chat endpoints now return unified Claude experience chats (beta, Enterprise), and Claude Docs documents can be downloaded as Word files (beta).

items.title: Building on our commitment to American scientific discovery
items.summary: Listed on Anthropic's news page; the listing gives the title only.

items.title: Introducing the Anthropic Cyber Mission
items.summary: Listed on Anthropic's news page; the listing gives the title only.

items.title: 2026 Usage Policy update
items.summary: Anthropic published an updated Usage Policy.

items.title: Faster steering in Codex
items.summary: Codex in the ChatGPT desktop app responds faster when you redirect a running task; a setting chooses whether follow-ups steer the current run or wait. Seen on a mirror of the release notes, so confirm on OpenAI's page.

items.title: Sonnet 5.5 prompt cache reads get cheaper
items.summary: Prompt cache reads for Claude Sonnet 5.5 dropped to $0.10 per million tokens.

items.title: Monthly API credits on Max and Team plans
items.summary: Claude Max and Team plans now include monthly API credits.

items.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5
items.summary: Anthropic describes it as its fastest, cheapest and most capable small model yet, built for high-volume, cost-sensitive work.

items.title: GPT-6 with Intelligent UI
items.summary: ChatGPT can mix text, visuals and interactive tools such as calculators into answers. Paid tiers get it first; Free and Go a day later.

items.title: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program
items.summary: An expanded version makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.

items.title: Audio uploads
items.summary: Attach audio files to get transcripts, summaries or structured notes. Paid plans and workspaces; availability varies by region and settings.

items.title: Text watermarking begins in the EU
items.summary: OpenAI said it will add an invisible watermark to text generated by ChatGPT and Codex in the EU, rolling out over the coming weeks. Reported by TechCrunch, so confirm on OpenAI's page.

items.title: Paid weekly Work and Codex resets
items.summary: Eligible personal Plus and Pro users may buy an immediate reset; it changes the next weekly reset date and pulls the normal allowance forward.

items.title: $100 million to train 10,000 engineers
items.summary: Anthropic is investing in training programs to address the enterprise AI talent gap.

items.title: Finances expands to Free and Go
items.summary: Finances in ChatGPT began rolling out to Free and Go users.

items.title: Claude Code weekly limits remain 25% higher than before its promotion
items.summary: The 50% promotion ended, but eligible Pro, Max, Team, and legacy seat-based Enterprise users kept a 25% weekly-limit increase. Claude chat and Cowork were unchanged.

items.title: OpenAI’s one-time global Codex reset for eligible plans
items.summary: OpenAI applied a global reset on September 7 after offering eligible users banked resets on September 3 and 4. These were one-time launch offers, not permanent limit increases.
